text.p: Sao Paulo state power utility company Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL) said it planned to pay dividends of 1.81 reais ($1.72) per 1,000 shares, or 30 percent of its 1996 net profit of 118.9 million reais.
CPFL's dividend payment proposal is likely to be approved by the state assembly in the next few days, a company spokesman said.

He added that the company's 1996 earnings jumped 330.6 percent over 1995 losses of 51.5 million reais, mainly due to a rise of 5.4 percent in electricity sales coupled with an electricity rate increase of roughly 21 percent in late 1995.
CPFL's net operational revenues rose 31.5 percent to 1.282 billion reais in 1996 against 975 million reais in 1995, he added.
Last year, CPFL sold 16,704 gigawatts of electricity and increased its number of clients by four percent to 2.3 million.
